ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Nov-15-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing on Name Change. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patrick Heard. Petitioners, Anthony Sicialiano and Margaret Greenwood were sworn and examined. Good cause appearing, the Court grants the Decree changing Petitioner's name to Claire Sicialano Greenwood. Decree signed in open court.
